title: Bind rounded relative error to two retimed P104 native children
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR2878's recovery lemma assumes a completed relative Hilbert defect for every transport. This package supplies a finite rounded reference implementation for PR2725's actual X90/N90 rank-seven/eight calls, including both monomial wrappers, exact entrance embedding and retained output grids. A same-grid counterexample and a failed final downcast show which representation promises are necessary.

Nick Petalas / PR2771 already supplies the unitary-stage error sum, maximum-component block scale and common-grid relative counterexample. Those methods are explicitly credited; the delta is their source-bound application to these two different P104 recipes, a separate exact-integer implementation and closed tensor oracle, and an integer-width/work envelope. The sufficient policy is `F=max(f,b+7-h)`, where h is the entrance maximum-component binary exponent; the computed output has relative Hilbert error at most `2^-b`. This numerical reference pays every scalar butterfly. It is not a fast recursive child or new general error lemma.

Only `research/p104-rounded-native-child/` is added. PR2725 is pinned at `71d24b655c2fdddc063b9aaf285e8425ce197499`, with literal source SHA256/Git blobs. Source correctness/native chart binding remains inherited. The other 1,938 transports, ADD rounding, full-word recovery, owners/movement, efficient recursive implementation and a viable complete consumer remain open. No supplier, paid-profile improvement or new kappa is claimed; existing fixed-profile consumer obstructions remain.

## Validation

Validation: Windows AMD64 / CPython 3.12.10, standard library. All 1,024 exact basis columns, 120 rounded fixtures (42 with nonzero error), local/completed integer squared-norm checks, phase/precision/butterfly/downcast faults and five behavioral groups pass. The registered replay includes an optimized Git-free read-only child replay, source/typed-receipt rejection and output refusal. Primary certificate also passes on CPython 3.14.6. Exact committed-byte preflight passes for all eight package files and three live inputs. No hosted-CI, Linux, formal-kernel or selected cold replay is claimed.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-rounded-native-child
```

## Task and overlap

Started at main `ffbd90dd90dbe0055464f3a1411b25a3a4fdc6b8`; fast-forwarded to `38746ad3f6ffebcc0275e286b1dbb733d7c696dd` before publication. Guidance, priority 5, selected record and consumed source bytes were unchanged. Final overlap covered 486 open PRs and 1,543 Discussion records with complete pagination at 2026-10-16 07:37–07:38 UTC; arbitrary diffs, unpublished work and complete closed-PR bodies are outside coverage. Task `p104-side-correction` is explicitly changed to this numerical side result; no family expansion is inferred. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-18966620).

[Task card and precise scope key](https://github.com/Arham-Tahir64/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cfe7c810eb6a3461b7e9c737fd948fb991b6dd6a/research/p104-rounded-native-child/TASK.json). Endpoint fusion, ADD retiming and exact grids are already covered; PR2878 names the still-open rounded-child premise, which motivates the changed scope. The written estimate is for arbitrary entrance arrays; finite execution is restricted to these two literal 512-coordinate recipes. Nearest overlaps: [PR2771](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2771) supplies the credited general method on QQ16; [PR2878](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2878) propagates assumed defects; [PR2665](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2665) demonstrates a different private-cleanup failure despite locally allowed defects.

## Credit

Credit Vasek/flyingviper/PR2725, Nick Petalas/PR2771 and the exact-grid lineage, PR2878, commdata2338/PR2662, ywz65/PR2586/2497, Ross Richardson and the retained geometry/native/compiler ancestry. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, code, checks and writing; separate algorithms by the same assistant, no independent human review. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

[Structured next question and stop decision](https://github.com/Arham-Tahir64/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cfe7c810eb6a3461b7e9c737fd948fb991b6dd6a/research/p104-rounded-native-child/TASK.json): bind one admitted fast recursive implementation, including its magnitude scan, retained output grid, restoration and movement costs, to a viable consumer. That implementation and complete bill remain blockers; the scalar reference here does not inherit a recursive saving or justify another construction round.
